name: Tremor
description:
Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against each creature within medium range. On each win, the creature takes 1 damage.

Check a Condition. If the Condition you checked was Guilty, on each win, add HEART to the damage.

Describe the tremor.
successes:
✨: On each win, deal 1 additional damage.

🌞: On each win, the creature is knocked prone.
